name: com.naxytra/xytara-mcp-executor
title: xytara MCP Executor
description: Pay-per-call MCP tools and signed on-chain attestations: 20 free/day, then x402 or a spend key.

tools.name: summarize
tools.description: Extractive summary: returns the first sentences of the text (default 3, up to 10) capped at max_chars (default 600, 50-2000), taken from the first 4000 characters. Deterministic; it does not paraphrase. `truncated` is true when the source was longer than the considered window. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: zones.lookup
tools.description: Live DNS lookup of A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS and TXT records for a domain (a URL is accepted; its hostname is used; IDNs are punycoded). 2 s per query, ~5 s total. Per-record errors are reported in record_errors; if no record resolves at all the call fails and is not charged. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

hostname.description: Domain name or URL, for example example.com or https://example.com/page.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Lists the enabled tools with titles, descriptions and the price. Same information as tools/list. Free: never requires payment.

tools.name: reply.draft
tools.description: Builds a structured reply to a message: greeting to the sender (name detected from the sign-off, or sender_name), acknowledgement, every question and request found in the message listed with an answer placeholder, deadlines noted, and a tone-matched sign-off. Deterministic template: it organizes the reply but does not invent the answers (placeholders in [brackets]). Input up to 20000 characters. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

text.description: The message you are replying to.

tone.description: clear (default), concise, warm, friendly, or formal.

sender_name.description: Name to greet (otherwise detected from the sign-off).

your_name.description: Name to sign with (otherwise a [Your name] placeholder).

tools.name: json.validate
tools.description: Validates a JSON payload (any JSON value, or JSON text as a string) against a JSON Schema and returns valid plus every error with its JSON Pointer path. Supported keywords: type, required, properties, additionalProperties, items/prefixItems, enum, const, minimum/maximum, exclusiveMinimum/exclusiveMaximum, multipleOf, minLength/maxLength, pattern, minItems/maxItems, uniqueItems, min/maxProperties, allOf. A schema using other keywords ($ref, anyOf, oneOf, not, if/then) is rejected (not charged) rather than half-checked. Without a schema only well-formedness is checked. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

payload.description: The JSON value to validate; a string is parsed as JSON text unless parse_string is false.

parse_string.description: Parse a string payload as JSON text (default true).

tools.name: text.extract
tools.description: Extracts emails, URLs (trailing punctuation stripped), IPv4 addresses, EVM addresses, transaction hashes, @mentions, #hashtags, prices, ISO/slash dates and phone numbers (dates, IPs and plain numbers are not reported as phones). Input up to 200000 characters; linear-time. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: html.to-text
tools.description: Converts HTML to readable plain text: drops scripts/styles/comments and all attribute text, keeps paragraph and list structure, separates table cells with " | ", decodes numeric and common named entities, and returns the <title> separately. Input up to 250000 characters; single linear pass. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: text.chunk
tools.description: Splits text into chunks of at most max_chars (100-20000, default 2000) preferring paragraph, line, sentence and word boundaries, with optional overlap (up to half of max_chars). Sizes are UTF-16 code units; surrogate pairs (emoji) are never split. Input up to 250000 characters. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

overlap.description: Characters repeated between consecutive chunks (default 0, capped at max_chars/2).

tools.name: x402.decode
tools.description: Decodes an x402 payment challenge (base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, or the JSON; v2 `amount` and v1 `maxAmountRequired`) into networks, assets, human amounts and payTo. A challenge with no payment options fails (not charged). Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

challenge.description: Base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED value, challenge JSON text, or the challenge object.

tools.name: keccak256
tools.description: Ethereum keccak256 of the input: returns the 32-byte digest and the 4-byte selector. encoding auto (default) hashes 0x-hex input as bytes and anything else as UTF-8 text; force utf8 or hex explicitly. The empty string is allowed. Up to 250000 bytes. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

data.description: Data to hash, e.g. transfer(address,uint256) or 0xdeadbeef.

tools.name: address.validate
tools.description: Checks an EVM address: format (0x + 40 hex), EIP-55 checksum (for mixed-case input), zero address, and returns the checksummed form. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: x402.verify-receipt
tools.description: Decodes an x402 PAYMENT-RESPONSE receipt and checks Base / Base Sepolia: settlement_confirmed is true only if the tx succeeded and its logs contain a USDC Transfer to the expected payTo (pay_to, else this server's) for the expected amount (amount, else this server's price) from the stated payer. RPC unavailable, unknown network or a receipt without a tx fails (not charged). Price: $0.02 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.002 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402 or 6 credits with a spend key; failed calls are not charged. The result carries a signed attestation (naxytra-attestation/1, in result._meta["naxytra.com/attestation"]) of what was observed on-chain — verified true or false — that you can hand to a third party; keys at /.well-known/delivery-receipt-keys. Anchoring: each attestation carries a chronology-protocol binding tag inside its signed bytes, and naxytra submits its digest (only the digest) to the next anchoring epoch. Once that epoch is published, anyone can check, with no account and no trust in naxytra, that the attestation existed no later than the public Bitcoin blocks holding its OpenTimestamps proofs: the bundle verifies offline, and the Bitcoin step needs only a public block explorer or your own node. Epochs run about monthly; there is no anchoring SLA. No extra charge. Status: GET https://api.naxytra.com/v1/anchoring/<attestation_id>.

receipt.description: Base64 PAYMENT-RESPONSE value, settlement JSON text, or the object.

pay_to.description: Expected merchant address (default: this server's payTo).

amount.description: Expected amount in USDC base units (default: this server's price when pay_to is this server).

confirm.description: false = decode only, no on-chain check (default true).

tools.name: tx.status
tools.description: Looks up a transaction by hash on Base mainnet (default) or Base Sepolia: success/failed/pending, block, confirmations, from, to, value and gas. network accepts eip155:8453, base, 8453, eip155:84532, base-sepolia, 84532. A hash unknown to the chain is reported clearly as found:false. ~5 s budget; RPC unavailable fails (not charged). Price: $0.02 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.002 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402 or 6 credits with a spend key; failed calls are not charged. The result carries a signed attestation (naxytra-attestation/1, in result._meta["naxytra.com/attestation"]) of what was observed on-chain — verified true or false — that you can hand to a third party; keys at /.well-known/delivery-receipt-keys. Anchoring: each attestation carries a chronology-protocol binding tag inside its signed bytes, and naxytra submits its digest (only the digest) to the next anchoring epoch. Once that epoch is published, anyone can check, with no account and no trust in naxytra, that the attestation existed no later than the public Bitcoin blocks holding its OpenTimestamps proofs: the bundle verifies offline, and the Bitcoin step needs only a public block explorer or your own node. Epochs run about monthly; there is no anchoring SLA. No extra charge. Status: GET https://api.naxytra.com/v1/anchoring/<attestation_id>.

tools.name: abi.encode
tools.description: Solidity ABI encoding (like abi.encode): address, bool, uint8-256, int8-256, bytes1-32, bytes, string, dynamic T[] and fixed T[k] arrays, and tuples written (uint256,address), nested to any depth. Strict: exact 20-byte (checksum-valid) addresses, range-checked integers, exact bytesN length, JSON true/false for bool, JSON arrays for arrays and tuples. Integers as decimal strings (or safe JSON numbers). Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: abi.decode
tools.description: Decodes ABI-encoded hex for the given types (same type support as abi.encode). Strict: every length and offset is bounded by the data present, dirty padding bits and trailing bytes are rejected, and calldata with a 4-byte selector is flagged. Integers are returned as decimal strings, addresses checksummed. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

types.description: Solidity ABI types to decode into.

tools.name: merkle.verify
tools.description: Verifies a keccak256 Merkle proof. leaf, root and every proof entry must be 0x 32-byte hashes (hash_leaf:true keccak-hashes a raw leaf first). sorted:true (default) is OpenZeppelin MerkleProof (sorted pairs); sorted:false needs leaf_index or positions to order each pair. Up to 256 proof entries. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

leaf.description: 0x 32-byte leaf hash (or raw data with hash_leaf:true).

proof.description: Sibling hashes from leaf to root.

positions.description: For sorted:false: the side of each sibling.

hash_leaf.description: keccak256 the leaf before verifying (default false).

tools.name: eip712.hash
tools.description: Computes the EIP-712 digest, domain separator, struct hash and encodeType from domain, types, primaryType and message (what wallets sign, including the x402 USDC TransferWithAuthorization). Every field is type-checked; a missing field fails with missing_field:<path> (not charged). Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

domain.description: EIP-712 domain: name, version, chainId, verifyingContract, salt.

primaryType.description: The primary struct type to hash.
